title: PhysxCookedDataAPI
summary: Cooked-data storage on a collider (uchar[] physxCookedData:<inst>:buffer). The parser reads none of it: geometry is cooked from the geometry columns by the cooking service and its cache.
producer_scope: Published like any applied multi-apply API; the buffer is a uchar array per instance.
notes: Listed so a Stage carrying stored cooked data is not refused by the compiled cache; it owns no column because the ovruntime parser never reads physxCookedData:*.
